description: This Java class 'EntityViewImportService' handles the import and synchronization of EntityView objects within the Thingsboard platform, including setting ownership, preparing data, saving/updating entities, and post-save processing.

classes.name: EntityViewImportService
classes.description: Service class for importing and synchronizing EntityView entities, extending BaseEntityImportService with specific logic for EntityView.

methods.name: setOwner
methods.description: Sets the tenant and customer IDs for the EntityView.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the EntityView for import by setting its internal entity ID.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates the EntityView entity.

methods.name: onEntitySaved
methods.description: Performs post-save actions, including updating entity view attributes.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the EntityView.

methods.name: cleanupForComparison
methods.description: Cleans up the EntityView for comparison, nullifying customer ID if it is a null UID.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the EntityType for this service, which is ENTITY_VIEW.
